comment: Every item in the game. value is the shop price in coins; shops buy back at 40%. Items don't stack unless stackable is true. tool.bonus is added to the chance of success per attempt. heals is hitpoints restored when eaten. equip: the slot it is worn in, its attack/strength/defence bonuses, and the level needed (Attack for weapons, Defence for armour; 1 when left out). Weapons all attack every 4 ticks; style picks the animation. Axes and pickaxes can be wielded and still work as tools.
